title: AI VTuber Scene Context Snapshot
description: Bounded, versioned, provider-neutral scene context (issue #88 S1, ADR-0007 D-3 and D-10). Serialized form of aivtuber_domain::SceneContextSnapshot: a closed scene class, at most 8 closed-vocabulary labels, an interruptibility hint, the source rank each field came from, and a monotonic version. There is no free text, no scene name and no caption in this contract. It is carried as the optional `scene` member of the Reflex context and of the Thinking request context, and recorded in the Reflex decision replay record, so a replayed decision names the exact snapshot it used. Authority rule: only a trusted source (rank 1 to 3: trusted_telemetry, obs_state, trusted_timer) can carry an interruptibility other than unknown; a perceived scene (rank 4) is untrusted model output and can inform a decision but never busy, deferral or interruptibility. Chat cannot assert any field: the snapshot is built by the runtime from OBS state and the perception tracker, never from an event. observed_at_ms is on the monotonic or logical timeline of the runtime, never wall-clock time. The rank, emptiness and interruptibility rules are expressed below and re-checked by the Rust validator; the rule that source_ref, confidence and calibrated appear only when a perceived field exists is not expressible in JSON Schema and is checked by the Rust validator and scripts/validate.mjs.

version.description: Monotonic per runtime run, starting at 1; increases on every change of any other field.

scene_class.description: Closed scene and stream-segment vocabulary. unknown exactly when source_rank is none. Perception can only produce gameplay, menu, loading, cutscene, result and desktop; just_chatting and intermission come from trusted OBS state.

labels.description: Closed label vocabulary (final; replaces the ADR-0007 S1a provisional list, same tokens).

interruptibility.description: A hint for trusted scheduling only. Anything but unknown requires a trusted source_rank.

source_rank.description: Rank of the source that supplied scene_class and interruptibility.

labels_source_rank.description: Rank of the source that supplied labels; none exactly when labels is empty.

source_ref.description: Operator alias of the perception source, present only when a field is perceived. Never a scene name, window title or path.

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence of the perceived part; absent for trusted sources. Not a probability unless calibrated.

observed_at_ms.description: Logical time of the newest observation that contributed; 0 when no source did.

source_rank.description: ADR-0007 D-3 rank 1 to 5. trusted_telemetry and trusted_timer are reserved (no source yet).
